groups: Confirmed-absent creation, opaque fields, defensive clones, exclusive locks, renew and final release
Load failures, invalid schemas and data never create a writable replacement; bounded retries
Budget gating, expired lease recovery and fencing against stale writers
Cash and receipt share one atomic profile write; acknowledged-late retry is idempotent
Ambiguous single-profile writes freeze writes until authoritative recovery
A lost creation acknowledgement never recreates an existing starter/profile
Two-profile ownership changes commit once, without duplicate items or extra participants
All twelve before/after cross-write crash boundaries recover complete ownership exactly once
Known preparation failures abort cleanly and preserve both original profiles
A committed journal cannot roll back after an ambiguous commit response
Committed transfers stay committed when finalization fails; only unresolved profiles block writes
Decision lease expiry prevents a stale coordinator from committing prepared profiles
Missing or mismatched recovery journals fail closed without replacing data
Repeated UpdateAsync callbacks and release retries preserve absolute snapshots and write IDs
runtime: Official Luau CLI executing production ProfileStore verbatim
limitations: Injected atomic DataStore API doubles; live DataStore availability, request budgets and Roblox shutdown timing require Studio/live verification.
